meaning: “Ya heard me” is a phrase commonly used throughout New Orleans and Louisiana. Meaning ‘you feel me,’ it is often used at the end of a sentence for emphasis. 21 is doing just this, emphasising his last bars through the use of ‘you heard me?’

line: One thing ’bout them tables, they just don’t stop
vault_lines: But one thing ’bout them tables, they just don’t stop turning
meaning: A playback machine for vinyl phonograph records, turn the tables means to reverse a situation and gain the upper hand so this is a clever word play as to illustrate karma

line: Niggas out of pocket, grab the pool stick
vault_lines: Niggas out of pocket, grab the pool stick
meaning: Pool is a classification of cue sports played on a table with six pockets along the rails, into which balls are deposited. 21 says he’s going to put the people who are out of pocket in place (just like you put the balls in the pockets with the pool stick), referencing the game.

line: I don’t play tennis, but the models, they serve me
vault_lines: I don't play tennis, but the models, they serve me
meaning: 21 may not play tennis but the models serve 21 like a “tennis serve” which is the move in Tennis in which the player who is serving throws the ball in the air and hits it to their opponent to start the match.

line: He threw in a white flag, but I still want beef (Stupid)
vault_lines: He threw in a white flag, but I still want beef (Stupid)
meaning:
Most commonly used among soldiers during wars, a white flag is a globally recognised symbol that represents a willingness to surrender, or a plea to negotiate during conflict.

21 Savage doesn’t pay mind to the fact that his enemies have thrown in a white flag and wish to surrender – he won’t stop until he sees their downfall.

21 has denounced the use of a white flag in a few of his tracks, including in the 2019 unreleased track, “HETHEN”:

White flags, nigga, we don’t hang ‘em

As well as in his 2016 single “Oh Ok”:

21 Gang and we don’t throw no white flags, nigga

line: Had a wedding for my Glocks, call ’em Jay and Bey (21)
vault_lines: Had a wedding for my Glocks, call 'em Jay and Bey (21)
meaning:
21 Savage shouts out a popular musical couple, Jay-Z and Beyoncé who have been married since 2008.



21 compares his handguns to the couple as they are a pair as well.

line: Came from the bottom, I’m a multimillionaire, I was just sleeping on pallets (21)
vault_lines: Came from the bottom, I'm a multimillionaire, I was just sleeping on pallets (21)
meaning:
21 Savage calls Zone 6, East Atlanta his hometown which is a poor community that is also home to rappers like Future and Gucci Mane. His struggle as a youth has been the topic of many of his tracks such as “No Heart”, “Numb”, and many more.

As of 2019, his estimated net worth is $8 Million.

line: If they love me or they hate me, it don’t make no difference (Cardi)
vault_lines: If they love me or they hate me, it don't make no difference (Cardi)
meaning:
Cardi B has dealt with a lot of controversies throughout her career such as her drugging men and  being involved in Rita Ora’s controversial song “Girls”.

However, regardless of these controversies and rumors of her being a “one-hit wonder” after the success of “Bodak Yellow”, Cardi has still garnered success. She has three number one singles, seven top-ten hits, and her Billboard number-one debut album Invasion of Privacy broke the record for the most streamed album by a female artist in its first week.

At the end of the day, the more controversy comes Cardi’s way, the more she’ll rise.

line: Cardi, from the block
vault_lines: Cardi, from the block
meaning:
This is likely a shoutout to fellow Bronx native Jennifer Lopez and her signature hit “Jenny from the Block.” Appearing on her 2002 album This Is Me… Then, the single reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and featured themes that would sound familiar to a Cardi fan:

Don’t be fooled by the rocks that I got
I’m still, I’m still Jenny from the block
Used to have a little, now I have a lot
No matter where I go I know where I came from (From the Bronx)

Cardi and JLo appeared together on the latter’s 2018 track “Dinero” and starred together in Hustlers, a September 2019 crime drama centered around strippers.

line: (Tay Keith, fuck these niggas up)
vault_lines: Fuck these rappers, I'm 4L gang, we the best like DJ Khaled (Straight up)
meaning: This is the producer tag of Brytavious Lakeith Chambers, also known as Tay Keith. Tay is a record producer and songwriter who has worked with big name artists, including Travis Scott and Drake on August 2018’s “Sicko Mode.”

line: See my ring, my watch, my chain and everything is lit, lit (Ice)
vault_lines: See my ring, my watch, my chain and everything is lit, lit (Ice)
meaning:
Cardi B has a various amount of expensive jewelry. For example, she has a $500,000 engagement ring, which her husband Offset proposed to her with, back in October 2017.

She also has a $400k Lola Bunny Chain she bought for Coachella in April 2018 and a $250,000 chain that read ‘Cardi B’ in May 2018.

She also has a $100,000 Patek Phillipe watch that she bought in 2016.

line: Feel like I’m the greatest rapper came out the South (Who want smoke?)
vault_lines: Feel like I'm the greatest rapper came out the South (Who want smoke?)
meaning:
21 grew up in East Atlanta, Georgia, which is located in the southern part of the United States.

21 faced some criticism on social media for this line because 21 was actually born in the United Kingdom and moved to the States when he was seven years old on an H-4 visa that was never renewed.

line: She keep tryin’ to fuck, I told her top me for now (On God)
vault_lines: She keep tryin' to fuck, I told her top me for now (On God)
meaning:
21 has stated his preference for fellatio over sexual intercourse on multiple occasions. For example, on 2015’s “Red Opps,” he raps:

Bitch, keep your legs closed ‘cause all I want is top

On the closing track from his debut studio album, Issa Album, “7 Min Freestyle,” 21 raps:

We don’t want that pussy, we just want that toppy, hoe

And on the lead single from Big Sean and Metro Boomin’s 2017 album Double or Nothing, “Pull Up N Wreck,” he raps:

I ain’t tryna fuck you, I just want some head, dawg

line: They say my time is almost up, tell them bitches, “Wish, wish”
vault_lines: They say my time is almost up, tell them bitches, "Wish, wish"
meaning:
Critics have often doubted Cardi B’s longevity since the success of her 2017 song, “Bodak Yellow.” However, she proceeded to debut atop the Billboard 200 with 2018’s Invasion of Privacy, had two more #1 songs on the Hot 100, and earned a Grammy for Best Rap Album in February 2019. She continues to prove her detractors wrong and tells them to “keep wishing” on her downfall because it’s not happening anytime soon.

The theme of Cardi’s imminent decline is recurring in her music. For example, on Quavo’s October 2018 track, “CHAMPAGNE ROSÉ,” she raps:

They say my time is tickin'
These hoes is optimistic

line: (What’s that on your wrist?) (I call it a chandelier)
vault_lines: I ain't got no free time, all my shit expensive
meaning:
This is an extract from DJ Khaled’s Snapchat. This clip was posted on January 7, 2019. He’s talking about his Patek Phillipe Nautilus watch, which is covered in diamonds, similar to how a chandelier looks with its glass.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ZvysVIfx7M

line: I know your mama taught you look both ways ’fore crossing me
vault_lines: I know your mama taught you look both ways 'fore crossing me (Lil' bitch)
meaning: 21 flips the phrase “look both ways before crossing the street” into a deep threat by replacing the street with himself. “Crossing” means crossing a street but also means to make someone angry.

line: Make this pistol blow both ways, I call it Hennessy (Pow!)
vault_lines: Make this pistol blow both ways, I call it Hennessy (Pow!)
meaning:
Cardi B has a sister named Hennessy Carolina. In June 2018, Hennessy revealed she was bisexual in an Instagram post, with the caption:

A bisexual girl expressing that she sometimes likes to kiss and hook up with girls especially when she gets a little loose when she drinks wine, Sounds human and normal to me! […] We don’t like to be the judge or to be labeled! We just want be excepted for who we are… Love is love!

line: Your bitch got that crazy head like a Kanye tweet (21)
vault_lines: Your bitch got that crazy head like a Kanye tweet (21)
meaning:
Kanye West is known for sharing his controversial political opinions on Twitter. For example, on April 25, 2018, Kanye went on a tweeting spree, from talking about his love for Donald Trump to saying how Barack Obama didn’t change anything in Ye’s hometown, Chicago during his presidency:

https://twitter.com/kanyewest/status/989179757651574784

https://twitter.com/kanyewest/status/989272340432240641

line: Leave that beefin’ shit at Ruth Chris or end up toothless
vault_lines: Leave that beefin' shit at Ruth Chris or end up toothless
meaning:
Ruth Chris Steakhouse is an upscale restaurant chain that headquartered in Winter Park, Florida. Their signature is serving, as the name suggests, steak but also serve entrees of lamb, chicken, fish, lobster, and shrimp.

Cardi juxtaposes “beef” to the restaurant. She isn’t interested in grudging with her haters and advises them to not mess her with her or there will be consequences.

line: Fuck these rappers, I’m 4L gang, we the best like DJ Khaled (Straight up)
vault_lines: Fuck these rappers, I'm 4L gang, we the best like DJ Khaled (Straight up)
meaning:
“4L” for means “for life.” In a November 2016 interview with DJ Small Eyez,  21 Savage’s cousin and close collaborator, Young Nudy defined the meaning behind the phrase:

That 4L, that shit for life. That shit really like some family shit, like everything for life. If you throw that 4L up, that shit for life.

We The Best Music Group is DJ Khaled’s record label and operates as an imprint of Epic Records. “We the best music” is also a phrase Khaled often proclaims in the intro of his songs.

line: Bought a Richard Mille, coulda bought me a house (No joke)
vault_lines: Bought a Richard Mille, coulda bought me a house (No joke)
meaning:
Richard Mille is a brand of luxury Swiss watches that can cost as much as $2 million. 21 boasts his wealth by saying that the amount of money he spent on a simple timepiece could have been used to purchase a home.

Richard Mille watches are a recurring theme in 21’s music.

On his December 2018 track, “asmr,” he raps:

Richard Mille cost so much I could push a button and see next week

On Offset’s February 2019 track, “Legacy,” he raps:

Richard Mille on me cost half a ticket, dawg

On DJ Snake’s April 2019 track, “Enzo,” he raps:

Richard Mille cost me a ‘Rari

Then, on ScHoolboy Q’s “Floating,” which was released only two days later, he rapped:

Richard Milles represent victory (21)

line: All this gold on a bitch, I feel like I’m Slick Rick
vault_lines: All this gold on a bitch, I feel like I'm Slick Rick
meaning: Cardi compares her jewelry to Slick Rick, a rapper famous for his love for gold accessories.
